method: Frozen 100 visible units, same visible release/hit facts, 0/900/9900 offscreen units (8 kinds, stationary/moving/charge/attack/cast states). Two independent WorldPresentation lifetimes per size. CPU 360 measured frames after real-draw preparation and 60 CPU warmup frames, one fresh snapshot per three frames (20 Hz). Full WorldPresentation and nested World3DLayer submission timed separately. 18 real three-pass frames verify actual WebGL completion; Canvas/GPU deferred cost is included in complete-wall upper bound. Camera blank+return probes and composited PNGs. preserveDrawingBuffer enabled only for capture. Snapshot construction, GC and simulation excluded from presentation. SwiftShader results are not hardware FPS.
